semantic_review_basis: Manually reread every original title/abstract evidence sentence and all candidate items. Checked facet roles, independent units, actual methods versus surveys/validation baselines, named resources, artifact coverage, finding subject/task/experiment scope, conditions, modalities, negation, comparators and magnitudes. Acceptance follows this source review, not a hash or grounding result.

problem.rationale: Polarity effects explicitly motivate considering negation in sentiment analysis; dropping the incidental common-construction description does not change the limitation.

method.rationale: The performed survey is retained; reviewed negation approaches and dimensions are not falsely recorded as implemented methods.

dataset.rationale: No named used or introduced resource is given.

contribution.rationale: The presented survey is the artifact; no unsupported empirical findings are added.

problem.rationale: The NLI antecedent, database setting, systematic-comparison gap, and functionality/expressive-power purpose are clear.

task.rationale: The evaluation of 24 interfaces using ten questions retains its target and goal.

method.rationale: Overview, question-based evaluation, and categorization are actual operations. The category names remain inside the taxonomy.

dataset.rationale: The ten-question list remains unnamed and is correctly not turned into a named resource.

contribution.rationale: All three findings now explicitly retain database-NLI scope. Simple questions, subqueries/structural dependencies, and manual-rule dependence remain intact; overview and taxonomy artifacts are supported.

problem.rationale: Rising spam volume and poor manual-keyword filters are both explicit; the filter antecedent is supplied.

task.rationale: Performance investigation of two learning algorithms for anti-spam filtering is the stated objective.

method.rationale: Both primary comparison algorithms are actually studied. The external keyword filter is retained only as the result comparator.

dataset.rationale: The publicly available corpus has no supplied name; benchmark aspiration does not create one.

contribution.rationale: The cost-sensitive measures are introduced artifacts. The finding names both methods, retains accurate spam filtering, and names the keyword-filter comparison without inventing numbers.

problem.rationale: The specific Settlers of Catan expert-challenge implementation gap is supported.

task.rationale: Policy acquisition retains the actual Settlers of Catan game context.

method.rationale: Online learning, corpus mining, and the retrieval/simulation decision workflow cover actual components and their operational integration. A redundant generic hybrid parent is unnecessary.

dataset.rationale: The game-play corpus is unnamed; the game name is not a dataset.

contribution.rationale: The revised finding defines the hybrid model, identifies the Settlers agent setting, and preserves preliminary experiments and potential. The A1 superiority hypothesis is not converted into a result.

problem.rationale: The intensional/extensional separation antecedent and complex-domain unclear-boundary limitation are complete.

task.rationale: The integrated task facet covers both formal-property objectives and practical axiomatization, rather than only A6. These are explicit theory/demonstration activities.

method.rationale: Contextual and HiLog semantics are separately proposed methods. The logic/languages under analysis are not extra algorithm or dataset labels.

dataset.rationale: OWL-Full/OWL-DL are ontology languages and SHOIQ is a logic; no named ontology resource is provided.

contribution.rationale: Both semantics artifacts and all findings retain undecidability's cause, the SHOIQ extension and either-semantics condition, and the clear HiLog antecedent with can-be-used modality.

problem.rationale: Shared-gene-only similarity can mislead, with variable combinations and complex-disease conditions preserved.

task.rationale: Disease similarity is the application objective. Term/entity operations are retained fully in methods and artifacts; separate computational-subtask labels are not required for coverage.

method.rationale: The two introduced similarity functions retain their independent term/entity targets and joint co-occurrence/information-content basis. Exact matches and gene overlap are validation baselines, retained in the result rather than the proposed method.

dataset.rationale: Gene Ontology is a named structured resource actually used. The manually curated benchmark, external test set, and microarray datasets remain unnamed.

contribution.rationale: Both function artifacts and all important concrete findings are retained. Every A8 recall/precision pair, the external-set Pearson 0.73 comparison, and related-disease microarray scope remain intact. The generic A6 statement need not be duplicated as a broader independent outcome when the concrete comparison is retained.

problem.rationale: The lack of human-labeled resources is explicit motivation.

task.rationale: The typological-information NLP literature-survey objective is retained.

method.rationale: Only the actual survey is treated as performed. Advocacy and possible data-driven developments remain future research direction.

dataset.rationale: No typological database name is supplied.

contribution.rationale: The causal finding now repeats the typological-information/system-performance antecedent with to-date/modest scope, both database limitations, and under-utilization. The separate performance finding and explanation retain distinct predicates without losing the relationship.

problem.rationale: No explicit prior limitation is stated; later training-time cost is not reclassified as motivation.

task.rationale: The word-order comparison objective is explicit.

method.rationale: Both genuinely compared model families and their evaluated combination are covered. The comparative-study exception applies.

dataset.rationale: Parsed training data, raw text, and standard benchmark remain unnamed.

contribution.rationale: All five findings now retain word-order scope, including the combined benchmark result. Relatively small, can benefit, overall better, much more training time, error distributions, and benchmark context are preserved.

problem.rationale: Investigation/attention to bias does not establish a prior specific failure; the observed bias remains a result.

task.rationale: Automatic pre-annotation's effect on manual POS annotation retains quality, time, and bias dimensions.

method.rationale: The actual Penn Treebank manual-annotation protocol includes from-scratch and pre-annotation conditions; no human is labeled as a technique.

dataset.rationale: Penn Treebank corpus is explicitly used; citation year is not invented as a dataset version.

contribution.rationale: The revised labels preserve manual POS, corpus, and setup context. Quality gain remains joined to the bias caveat; speed retains even a not-so-accurate tagger and can help. No quantitative gain is invented.

problem.rationale: No explicit prior failure is given; prospective efficiency/precision directions are not turned into an established problem.

task.rationale: Compute the parse forest and extract best parses is the operational target.

method.rationale: Contractions, weighted FST expression, and the parsing workflow are actual presentation content. Splitting related components is acceptable here and does not claim separately benchmarked systems.

dataset.rationale: No named used or introduced data resource is supplied.

contribution.rationale: Construction, algorithm, modal parsing-mode capability, and projective complexity findings are present. The extension retains can and prior high-recall provenance; complexity keeps experiments support an analysis, worst-case qualification, and all scaling factors.

problem.rationale: Formal-logic obstacle, absent prior Arabic support, and limited Arabic NLP are all explicit; prior-interface antecedents are supplied.

task.rationale: Arabic-question input and ontology-based answer output define the user objective.

method.rationale: Triples/RDF matching, separate linguistic and semantic feature groups, and defined grammar rules are actual components. No intensive sophisticated linguistic method is added against A6's negation.

dataset.rationale: All ontology/knowledge-base and two-dataset mentions are unnamed; SW/RDF/Arabic are not resource names.

contribution.rationale: The named interface, explicitly proposed translation procedure, and explicitly defined grammar-rule artifact have distinguishable authored content. The two-dataset good precision/recall finding remains qualitative and correctly scoped.

problem.rationale: The source explicitly identifies ignored temporal variation in existing rumor features.

task.rationale: Automatic rumor identification in online social media, especially microblogs, is explicit.

method.rationale: The current temporal approach resolves its feature antecedent to content/user/propagation information and actually applies lifecycle time-series modeling.

dataset.rationale: The two microblog datasets are unnamed.

contribution.rationale: The artifact is explicit; outperformance retains two-dataset event scope, state-of-the-art comparator, and large margins. The early result now includes the same experiment setting and early-after-initial-broadcast condition without adding numbers.

limitations: This is an AI final-revision acceptance of the integrated candidate after source review, not a new blind pass, human gold, independent human review, corpus-wide policy certification, or a model score.
rollout_control: No full annotation rollout performed. Root acceptance.json remains required.
